properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome S3, 2026-09-18): 'snapshot_before_change listed EVERY required argument at once … it is not yet the default on other tools' — MEASURED: every constructor (21 add_* plus genesis and record_finding) already lists all missing fields at once through one helper; the tools that still refuse one field per round trip are the ones whose required fields are enforced by deserialization — link_artifact and every edge/setter tool
properties.source: bhome feedback.md, Session 3 (2026-09-18), triaged 2026-09-19 through the triage-feedback skill
properties.statement: Reporter praised snapshot_before_change for naming every missing argument and said the behaviour is not the default elsewhere. MEASURED in the tool modules: RequiredFields::new appears in 22 handlers — all constructors — so the report is right only for the non-constructor surface, where a missing required field is serde's 'missing field `x`' and stops at the first. dec:idea-should-a-refusal-teach-every-rule-it-knows-in-one-reply (OPEN) already holds this question; epoch:a-missing-argument-names-the-tool-and-what-it-wants arrived for the constructors. CAUSE: the helper is applied where Option fields are checked in code; fields required by the request struct itself are refused by the deserializer, one at a time, and nothing lists them together.
